That’s why Appspace helps companies create a better working experience for every workplace and every employee. Because when people love where they work, they can accomplish incredible things. Today, work happens everywhere, and Appspace brings together the physical and digital workplaces by improving communication, organization, and productivity. Our platform is easy to set up, works with your existing technology, and flexes to fit your company’s needs. Featuring dozens of app integrations, it works best however you work best and improves how you collaborate with your colleagues—plus, it simplifies work processes so you can get things done faster and easier. With a platform that’s built for how you work, we’re helping businesses like yours replace point products that don’t work well together with an organized, engaging workplace experience platform that’s a joy to use. United Kingdom Remote](https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/appspace/jobs/6238019004) | ## Find your team - Customer This team makes sure customers have a positive experience using Appspace solutions and services. We aim to develop strong, lasting relationships with customers, giving them  the support and resources they need to get the most from Appspace. - Sales We work collaboratively with marketing, partners, and our technical experts to make a great impression and create a smooth and successful buying journey.  We drive Appspace’s growth by developing new relationships in our target markets and deepening customer relationships. We set the tone with product overviews, success stories, and – most importantly – a keen desire to learn about our buyers’ needs. - Product We’re a team of product managers, designers, and strategists who are passionate about creating the best possible experience for our users. Our mission is to understand our customers’ needs and create solutions that help them communicate and collaborate more effectively. From ideation to launch, we work with cross-functional teams to build products that are intuitive and innovative. - Accounting, Finance, Legal & Business Operations We're the number crunchers and financial wizards who manage the company’s finances and ensure we’re on track  to meet our goals. Our mission: to provide accurate, timely financial information to help Appspace make informed business decisions. Our team of detail-oriented professionals is passionate about using financial data to drive business success. - Marketing It’s our job to tell our amazing innovation story and how we’re helping organizations around the world solve challenges related to communication, employee engagement, and workplace experience. Through our website, thought leadership, events, and campaigns, we showcase the power of Appspace to connect people, places and spaces. Our award-winning team includes experts in Content, Creative, Demand Gen, Marketing Operations, and Business Development. - People & Culture We’re the team that keeps the Appspace spirit alive. Our commitment to equality helps us attract and retain the best, most diverse talent and lays the foundation for everyone to build meaningful, inspiring careers. Great ideas happen when people feel safe and inspired to be authentic. - Technology We’re a group of tech enthusiasts who are passionate about creating innovative solutions for digital workplace communication and workplace experience. Our team is responsible for developing and maintaining the technology and infrastructure that powers the Appspace platform. Without this team, there’s no Appspace.
